title: Daya Ram Awasthi v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Sunita Agarwal and Krishan Pahal, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed; electricity bill relegated to Clause 6.5.
headnote: A writ challenging an electricity bill was dismissed. The consumer’s remedy is to approach the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Daya Ram Awasthi petitioned the Allahabad High Court against Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. and two others, challenging an electricity bill. Counsel appeared for the distribution company. The Division Bench did not inquire into the correctness of the bill or any connected facts. It recorded that the petitioner's remedy was to approach the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and dismissed the writ on that alternative remedy.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition raising a dispute about an electricity bill is dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy; the petitioner is to approach the Executive Engineer concerned by invoking Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: Writ against an electricity bill dismissed because Clause 6.5 supplies the alternative of approaching the Executive Engineer.
The Court treated Clause 6.5 as the statutory forum for the bill dispute and refused to decide it in writ.
The appropriate remedy stated on the face of the order is a representation to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.

not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the bill and relegated the petitioner to Clause 6.5.
